title: 第19章 拖刀客北枫第20章 不该问的不问
content_zh:
十里镇出了大事。
巡检司，被人一夜灭杀。
如果是寻常事情，镇里的豪绅可以帮忙代办。
但这么大的杀人案，官府的人不来，没人敢破坏现场。
可问题来了，后院死的，都是官府的人。
虽然天寒地冻，但发臭只是时间问题。
如此数量的尸体，不尽快处理，很可能引起瘟疫。
尸体是世豪酒楼的小厮早上过来时发现的。
此刻，小厮脸色惨白坐在酒楼前庭。
他身边围了很多父老乡亲。
除了几个胆子大的屠夫，没人敢越过前庭。
可人的好奇心最是难除。
不少人都够着头往后院的方向探。
只不过早被豪绅们差人拉了围布。
什么都瞧不见。
“二蛋，你倒是说说，人是怎么死的啊？”有人问道。
回想后院比地狱还要恐怖的画面。
小厮牙齿不停打颤。
他先是喝口水缓了缓。
接着心有余悸道：“我怎么敢上去查看，只晃眼看到满地都是脑袋和残肢，石板上全是血，我滴妈，比杀狗那地儿还血腥。”

“嘶！”
众人只知道死了人。
可却没想到死状会如此惨烈。
“到底是谁干的，那可是一百多号兵啊。”
“是不是最近涌进咱小镇的那些个逃犯？”
“怎么可能，就算她们拉帮结伙，也不至于灭了巡检司后，一个人都不折吧？”
大伙纷纷表达自己的观点。
“我知道是谁干的！”有人忽地冒出来。
“是谁？”众人惊道。
“十里镇剑神！”那人相当自信。
大伙顿时鄙视的看着他。
十里镇剑神。
第一次出现是张平死的时候。
可到底有没有这样一个人。
这个人还在不在十里镇。
都是臆测。
content_en:
Something big happened in Shili Town.
The Inspection Department was killed overnight.
If it is an ordinary matter, the gentry in the town can help with it.
But for such a big murder case, no one from the government would dare to damage the scene unless they came.
But here’s the problem, those who died in the backyard were all government officials.
Even though it’s freezing cold, it’s only a matter of time before things start to stink.
Such a large number of corpses, if not dealt with as soon as possible, is likely to cause a plague.
The body was discovered by a waiter from Shihao Restaurant when he came over in the morning.
At this moment, the waiter was sitting in the front yard of the restaurant with a pale face.
He was surrounded by many fellow villagers.
Except for a few brave butchers, no one dared to cross the vestibule.
Curiosity is the most difficult thing to get rid of.
Many people reached up and looked toward the backyard.
It's just that the gentry had already sent people to pull the cloth around.
Can't see anything.
"Erdan, please tell me how people died?" someone asked.
Recall the scene in the backyard that was scarier than hell.
The boy's teeth kept chattering.
He first drank some water to calm down.
Then he said with lingering fear: "How dare I go up to check, but in a blink of an eye I saw heads and stumps all over the floor, and the stone slab was covered with blood. Oh my god, it's bloodier than the place where a dog was killed."
"Hiss!"
Everyone only knows that people are dead.
But I didn't expect that the death would be so tragic.
"Who did it? There were more than a hundred soldiers."
"Are they the fugitives who have poured into our town recently?"
"How is it possible? Even if they form a gang, they won't be able to defeat anyone after destroying the inspection department, right?"
Everyone expressed their opinions one after another.
"I know who did it!" Someone suddenly appeared.
"Who is it?" everyone asked in shock.
"Shili Town Sword God!" The man was quite confident.
Everyone immediately looked at him with contempt.
The Sword God of Shili Town.
The first time it appeared was when Zhang Ping died.
But is there such a person?
Is this person still in Shili Town?
It's all conjecture.
